posts.title: Mexa-se: Pausas Ativas Melhoram Energia
posts.excerpt: Faça pequenas pausas para alongar ou caminhar. Isso alivia a tensão muscular, melhora a circulação e renova sua energia para continuar produtivo.

posts.title: Move More: Active Breaks Boost Energy
posts.excerpt: Take short breaks to stretch or walk. This relieves muscle tension, improves circulation, and renews your energy to stay productive.

posts.excerpt: Mantenha-se hidratado ao longo do dia. Beber água regularmente melhora o foco, a energia e a saúde geral. Tenha sempre uma garrafa por perto.

posts.title: Drink Water: Hydration Is Essential
posts.excerpt: Stay hydrated throughout the day. Drinking water regularly improves focus, energy, and overall health. Always keep a bottle nearby.

posts.title: Healthy Mind: Manage Your Stress
posts.excerpt: Dedicate a few minutes for a mental break. Breathe deeply, meditate, or focus on something positive. This reduces stress, increases clarity, and improves mood.
